summary: Tested the real ImprovedPINNCNN model and the tumor heatmap. Backend: 17/19 pytest pass, counting the iter2 auth regression suite (test_model_heatmap.py + test_auth_scans.py). /api/model-status: model_loaded=true, demo_mode=false, load_error=null, input_size=224, correct classes. /api/predict on meningioma_tumor_2 -> meningioma 99.4%, tumor_area_pct=7.5, heatmap is a valid 512x512 RGBA PNG data URL. no_tumor_1 -> no_tumor, pituitary_tumor_5 -> pituitary. The heatmap is not saved in Mongo and not returned by GET /api/scans/{id}; tumor_area_pct is saved. The model class matches the notebook's unet head exactly and the state_dict loads strictly. Frontend: all requested flows pass. heatmap-card shows the base blob image with the overlay aligned at the same 448x448 box, and the glow sits on the tumor. The toggle sets opacity 0.85 -> 0 -> 0.85, and the slider changes it (0.6 by keyboard, 0.3 by click). No demo banner. The 4 probability bars render and all 6 advice cards load. A no_tumor scan shows 'No region stands out' and 0.0%. Regression: /downloads lists all 4 samples, /about shows Model loaded Yes, and signed-in /history shows the new scan.

minor.issue: A corrupt or non-decodable file sent with an image/* content type returns 500 (PIL.UnidentifiedImageError from pinn_predictor.predict). It should be caught and returned as 400 'Please upload a valid MRI image'.
saved_name = f'{scan_id}_{mri.filename}' uses the client filename without sanitizing it. Use Path(mri.filename).name or the extension only, to avoid path-traversal or odd characters.

Tested on all 37 local samples in /app/scripts/mri_samples. 20/37 correct: pituitary 7/7, no_tumor 9/10 (no_tumor_11 -> meningioma), meningioma 4/10 (missed 4,5,7,8,11,12), glioma 0/10 (mostly predicted meningioma, pituitary or no_tumor). The architecture and preprocessing (Resize 224, ImageNet normalization, RGB, class order) match the notebook exactly, so this looks like domain shift between these samples (Sartaj-style filenames) and the training set (BrainTumor_RGB), or a checkpoint/variant mismatch. It is not a code bug. Consider telling the user, or checking that pinn_model.pth is the all_improvements checkpoint.

action_items: Wrap Image.open/predict in /api/predict with try/except (PIL.UnidentifiedImageError, OSError) and return HTTP 400 instead of 500
Sanitize the uploaded filename before writing to UPLOADS_DIR
Optional: tell the user about the low glioma accuracy on the sample set and confirm the checkpoint matches the 'all_improvements' variant
critical_code_review_comments: pinn_predictor._ensure_loaded caches _load_error permanently. A transient load failure keeps the app in demo mode until restart. This is acceptable but should be documented.

The heatmap glow also shows weaker activation outside the tumor (for example a midline band on meningioma_tumor_2). This is model output, but a threshold (e.g. zero alpha for u<0.2) would give a cleaner 'soft glow'.
The heatmap data URL (~tens of KB) is only in the predict response. If a user opens a past scan from /history, there is no heatmap. This is expected by design but worth noting in the UI.

success_rate.backend: 89% (17/19; 1 failure is the model's accuracy on glioma_tumor_1, 1 is the corrupt-image 500)

test_credentials: No passwords. A session was created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md (test_credentials.md present).
seed_data_creation: Temporary test user/session (test.user.it3*) and TEST_* scans were created and then deleted.
